details:
VRChat Version:
SDK 2021.11.24.16.20
Description of the bug:
Unity is unable to record an animation that swap material references in indexes #2 and #4 in the same animation.
Steps to reproduce (how did you encounter the bug?):
- Record an animation for any model with at least 5 materials.
- Add a Material Reference property for either index 2 or 4.
- Attempt to add a Material Reference for index 4 or 2 (depending on which you added originally)
- Watch as all parts of model that were using the first material magically get the material for the second.
Any extra files? (output logs, screenshots): I can send my entire project folder, upon request.
It appears that this is a super specific and oddball Unity bug that I'm running into where you're unable to swap materials #2 and #4 on a model, without it also swapping the other material. It appears that Unity has fixed this bug in 2021.2.0a17, but no clue when that'll be backported to the 2019 branch. Any idea what we can do to get this oddly specific bug fix to a version of Unity that we can use for VRChat, as it's making it very difficult to animate material swaps for an avatar?
For Reference, Bug is documented here: https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/issues/material-is-applied-to-two-slots-when-applying-material-to-a-single-slot-while-recording-animation
title: Specific Unity Bug When Animating Material Swap
